name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech inference in pure C++/ggml. Ships Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual variants) and Supertonic engines under a unified Engine API. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's tts-cpp/ subfolder. This pin brings PR #43 (QVAC-19557 chatterbox memory) on top of master 40c95c6e (which already carries QVAC-19305 Supertonic v3): streamed GGUF loads (no full-file host staging), EngineOptions::kv_cache_type (f32|f16|q8_0 T3 KV cache; q8_0 ~27% of f32) with a load-time capability probe + F32 fallback and a Vulkan q8_0->f32 guard, and removal of the last direct ggml-cpu backend-library symbol references so static tts-cpp links cleanly under Android GGML_BACKEND_DL=ON (lets the tts-ggml tts-cpp overlay be removed). Consumes the ggml-speech port.
